description: The plot illustrates the change in Word Error Rate (WER) during fine-tuning of the Whisper model for different configurations. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6 with a linear scale and integer tick labels at every epoch. The y-axis represents WER, ranging from 30 to 70 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Five lines are plotted: 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' (dark gray, dashed, circle markers), starting at approximately 68 at epoch 0 and decreasing to around 34 at epoch 6; 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' (dark gray, solid, square markers), starting at about 59 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 33 at epoch 6; 'tiny int4' (light gray, dashed, circle markers), beginning at around 64 at epoch 0 and ending at about 36 at epoch 6; 'tiny int8' (light gray, solid, square markers), starting at roughly 53 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 35 at epoch 6; and 'tiny full' (gray, dotted, triangle markers), starting at around 30 at epoch 0 and decreasing to about 25 at epoch 6. All lines show a general downward trend across the epochs, with the most significant decreases observed between epochs 0 and 4.
